## Type

- [ ] Correction or clarification
- [ ] Platform facts update (with source and date)
- [ ] New or changed test scenario
- [ ] Change to a module
- [ ] New module
- [ ] Change to the core (needs an issue and tests on two platforms)
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] Consistent with [docs/concepts.md](../docs/concepts.md) (epistemic ownership, two signatures, connect don't substitute, no retention mechanics)
- [ ] Follows the [style guide](../STYLE_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] No real learner data, conversations or identifying information anywhere
- [ ] If instructions changed: test results attached (platform, model, scenarios, pass/partial/fail)
- [ ] If a module was added: header complete, two scenarios included, listed in `channels/student/README.md`
